subject: general
question: In 2025, which State Government launched the 'RISE' app for digital monitoring of child vaccinations, enhancing training for health workers to improve immunisation coverage?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** launched the **‘RISE’ app in 2025** to digitally monitor child vaccinations and enhance training for health workers.
 
• The app focuses on improving **immunization coverage** by ensuring better tracking and accessibility of child vaccinations.
 
• Health workers are trained with the help of the app to ensure efficient implementation of vaccination programs in rural and urban areas.
 
• The initiative aligns with the **National Immunization Program** and is part of a larger effort to strengthen the healthcare infrastructure in the state.
 
• Uttar Pradesh, being one of the most populous states in India, has taken this step to address challenges in healthcare delivery and to ensure equitable vaccination coverage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Child Vaccination in India:**

 
 
• **Universal Immunization Programme (UIP):** Launched in **1985**, it is one of the largest health programs in the world, aiming to provide vaccination against preventable diseases.
 
• The UIP offers free vaccines for diseases like polio, tuberculosis, diphtheria, pertussis, tetanus, measles, hepatitis B, and others.
 
• India has achieved significant milestones, such as **polio eradication** and reduction in vaccine-preventable diseases.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Digital Monitoring in Healthcare:**
 
 
• Digital tools like the RISE app enhance **data tracking** and **real-time monitoring** of vaccination programs, improving efficiency and coverage.
 
• They help in identifying **missed children** and areas with low immunization rates.
 
• Digital platforms can also provide **training modules** for healthcare workers to improve their skills and knowledge.
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh Healthcare Initiatives:**
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh has been actively working on improving its healthcare services, focusing on maternal and child health programs.
 
• The state has launched several initiatives to combat malnutrition, improve sanitation, and enhance access to healthcare in rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Features of the RISE App:**
 
 
• The app is equipped with features to track **child vaccination schedules** and send reminders to parents and health workers.
 
• It provides **training modules** and resources for health workers to improve their service delivery.
 
• Integrated with government databases to ensure accurate and up-to-date records of vaccinated children.
